hero.title: Explore London's Best Sights
hero.description: Discover London's iconic Tower Bridge and enjoy stunning views of the River Thames, historic architecture, and the vibrant city skyline.

sights.name: Tower of London
sights.description: Explore one of London's most historic landmarks, famous for its medieval architecture, royal history and the Crown Jewels.
sights.tip: Visit early in the morning to enjoy the attraction before it gets busy.

sights.name: Buckingham Palace
sights.description: Visit the iconic royal residence and admire its grand architecture. You can also experience the famous Changing of the Guard ceremony.
sights.tip: Check the Changing of the Guard schedule before your visit.

sights.name: London Eye
sights.description: Enjoy spectacular panoramic views of London's skyline, the River Thames and famous landmarks.
sights.tip: Sunset is a great time for beautiful city views and photographs.

sights.name: Westminster Abbey
sights.description: Discover Westminster Abbey, a historic Gothic landmark and explore its magnificent architecture, royal heritage, and timeless beauty.
sights.tip: Visit Westminster Abbey in the morning, then explore Big Ben, the Houses of Parliament, and St. James’s Park on a scenic walking trip.

sights.name: Big Ben
sights.description: See the world-famous Big Ben and the Houses of Parliament in Westminster.
sights.tip: Evening visits give you a chance to see the landmark beautifully illuminated.

adventures.title: Up at The O2
adventures.description: Climb across the famous roof of The O2 and experience London from a completely different perspective.

adventures.title: Thames Speedboat Adventure
adventures.description: Experience London from the water on a thrilling high-speed boat adventure.

adventures.title: White Water Rafting
adventures.description: Take on the exciting rapids at Lee Valley White Water Centre.

nightlife.title: West End After Dark
nightlife.description: Experience London's famous West End after sunset with dazzling theatre lights, live performances and lively streets.

nightlife.title: Thames by Night
nightlife.description: See London's skyline illuminated at night while enjoying a relaxing evening beside the River Thames.

nightlife.title: Soho Evening
nightlife.description: Explore one of London's liveliest neighbourhoods, filled with restaurants, music venues and late-night entertainment.

nightlife.title: London Rooftop Evening
nightlife.description: Relax above the city with spectacular nighttime views and a stylish evening atmosphere.
